subject: Vendor intake & PO mapping — next steps and matrix
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborcloud.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@harborcloud.com
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Initial vendor intake + questions on PO issuance and line-items

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for agreeing to kick off vendor onboarding with us. Before we complete the vendor form, a couple quick clarifying questions from procurement so our finance team can line up billing:

- Does Redwood require a specific invoice remit-to address or PO number format? We currently send PO numbers as HC-#### but can include Redwood PO- prefix if required.
- Do you prefer consolidated monthly invoices or per-PO invoices? Our standard is per-PO, but we can consolidate on request.
- For services that mix usage and fixed fees (e.g., Hosted + Dedicated support), how do you expect line-items to be structured? Should we provide separate line-items per product (hosted API, dedicated reserve, support retainer) with unit prices and quantities?

We have a vendor intake PDF and a sample invoice PDF attached. Happy to hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Procurement
HarborCloud

-----Original Message-----

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborcloud.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:04:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial vendor intake + questions on PO issuance and line-items

Thanks for the clear questions, Maya — welcome, and glad to move this forward. Quick answers below and an ask for a couple of artifacts we need to complete vendor setup.

1) PO number format: Prefer Redwood-YYYY-XXXXX (e.g., Redwood-2026-00412). Please include that PO number in the invoice header and on each invoice line. If your system cannot add a prefix, include the Redwood PO in the invoice reference field and on the remittance stub.

2) Invoice cadence: We support both. For ease of reconciliation our default for new partners is per-PO invoicing, but we can accept consolidated monthly invoices if you will also include line-item breakdowns by PO and date range.

3) Line-item structure: Please provide separate top-level line-items per product family with these columns: SKU/Service code, description, unit type (hours/GB/month/flat), quantity, unit price, tax (if applicable), and total. For combined services (usage + retainer), include a retainer line (monthly flat) and separate usage lines with clear unit metrics. Attaching a PO_lineitem_matrix template — please fill and return.

Required artifacts to complete onboarding:
- Completed Redwood_vendor_intake_form (attached)
- W9/Tax form or equivalent (if US entity) or VAT registration (if EU)
- Sample invoice using your usual format + sample line-item mapping (one page)

Cc'ing Aditya (Finance) and Lauren (Legal operations) for any finance/legal constraints they want to call out.

Next steps: If you can return the completed intake + a filled PO_lineitem_matrix by EOD Friday 2026-05-22 we can target PO issuance the week of 05/25. If not, propose your earliest availability and we will adapt.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborcloud.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:18:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial vendor intake + questions on PO issuance and line-items

Hi Maya — quick finance notes from my side:

- Remit and tax: Our AP system requires a remit-to address and EIN for US suppliers. Please attach W9 and remit-to. If HarborCloud issues invoices from multiple legal entities, please indicate which legal name will appear on the invoice and whether we should set up multiple vendor records.
- PO timeline: If we receive completed intake + sample invoice by 05/22 EOD, procurement will create a PO draft within 2 business days and route for approvals (standard SLA is 3 business days). Once approvals are done, AP issues final PO number and sends to vendor. Target issuance: week of 05/25 as Tessa noted.
- Line-item granularity: We ask that usage-based charges include a unit of measure (e.g., tokens/GB/hours) so downstream cost allocations are straightforward. For support retainers, include billing period start/end on the line.

If HarborCloud needs a faster turnaround for a pilot, let me know and we can prioritize but may need a one-off credit hold until vendor setup completes.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@harborcloud.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:07:44 -0700

Thanks Tessa and Aditya — attached are the completed vendor intake form and a filled PO_lineitem_matrix.xlsx with sample SKUs and our invoice template (HarborCloud_vendor_details.pdf).

Notes:
- HarborCloud is a single US legal entity (HarborCloud, Inc.). EIN included on W9.
- We prefer per-PO invoicing.
- We’ve added separate usage lines (API calls / data transfer) and a monthly support retainer line.

Would appreciate confirmation on whether these map cleanly into Redwood’s PO matrix or if you need any renaming of SKUs.

Regards,
Maya

- Internal notes: Aditya — please confirm provisioning of a vendor record for HarborCloud, Inc. and whether payment terms (Net30) are set as default for this partner. Lauren — flagging any legal review required for the SOW we’ll attach to the PO; if there are material terms we should surface now, call them out.
